 Follow One Piece Chapter 1197 Spoilers & Manga Plot Leaks
 Ishita Verma Wed, October 28, 2026 at 6:59 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Toei Animation | Crunchyroll One Piece Chapter 1197 spoilers have now hit social media. In the previous chapter, Sanji finally overcame his weakness and prepared to kill Saint Killingham, who has combined with Ivankov. Here are all the details fans need to know about the plot leaks for Chapter 1197 of the One Piece manga.
 List of One Piece Chapter 1197 spoilers
 The spoilers for One Piece Chapter 1197 plot leaks are listed below.
 Sanji wants to protect his body
 In the chapter titled "Love is Defense," the main focus is on the fight between Sanji and Killingham. It starts with Sanji making saving his body his top priority during the battle, as he realizes it has helped him overcome life's hardships. Fans then see several panels depicting the battles Sanji has fought in his life. One shows him with Zeff, while in the others he appears alongside Reiju and his enemies, including Mr. 2 Bon Clay, Absalom, Jabra, Vinsmoke Judge, Wadatsumi, and many more.
 Killingham forms black armor
 He thinks about the bodies his siblings have and concludes that he would've already died if he had their structure. However, this is also the reason he has little regard for his own. He realizes that, apart from armament haki, he needs a defense to win this fight. Sanji keeps kicking Killingham, who is still in his hybrid form. To avoid that, Killingham coats himself in Omen, forming black armor that only Conqueror's Haki can break. Sanji then forms a new kind of flame on his leg, resembling Ifrit Jambe's flames.
 Sanji kicks Killingham
 The tip of Killingham's Longinus spear breaks when Sanji blocks it, but the impact knocks Sanji down. He examines the flames and realizes his armament Haki has reached a higher level. As a result, Sanji no longer feels pain from attacks. Sanji gets back up and describes himself as Luffy's shield, labeling Zoro the sword. Suddenly, black lightning appears, and Sanji hits Killingham with a spinning back kick combined with Conqueror's Haki. At the end of the chapter, his kick lands directly on Killingham's face, and he is seen spitting blood.
